Subject: Re: Pen test report request + NDA/redaction question

Hi Jonah — thanks for the clear timeline. Short answer: we can accommodate both approaches, with standard safeguards.

Options we typically offer:
- Option A: Provide a redacted executive summary (no PoCs, no internal IP or sensitive configurations). Can be delivered within 48 hours.
- Option B: Provide a redacted full report (findings + remediation details, but PoCs sanitized) under a standard vendor NDA (we prefer our template or a mutual NDA). Processing time ~3–5 business days pending legal review.
- Option C: Access-controlled view of the unredacted report (non-downloadable) for named reviewers only, after a countersigned NDA that includes retention limits and prohibition on reproduction.

What we need from Acme to proceed:
1) Which option you prefer (A/B/C) and who the named reviewers will be.
2) If you prefer NDA, please share your standard NDA or confirm you can sign our template.
3) Any specific redaction constraints (e.g., remove cloud account IDs, remove PoC exploit artifacts).

Attachments: a sample redacted exec summary and a proposed NDA link — the sample is for format only.

Ill loop in Legal and SecOps for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships, EMEA & Security Liaisons
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0183

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test report request + NDA/redaction question

Hi all — looping in Legal here. Jonah, thanks for the ask. A couple of practical points from our side:

- We can countersign Acme's NDA provided it does not include overly broad retention or disclosure rights. Typical redlines we require:
  * Data classification: security findings and exploit details are Confidential.
  * Retention: reports must be destroyed or returned 180 days after review unless a longer retention is expressly agreed.
  * No public disclosure without prior consent.
  * No requirement to indemnify Redwood for use of redacted information.

- We do not provide raw exploit code or scripts in reports shared externally. PoCs will be summarized at a high level or sanitized upon request.

- For Option C (access-controlled view), we use a short-lived link + IP restriction and name-based access; that is our preferred route for highly sensitive customers.

If Acme can share a copy of your standard NDA, I will run it through our legal review this afternoon. Alternatively we can send our mutual NDA (DocuSign link below).

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
